metadata.question: Based on satellite imagery from November 29, 2015, are both the locations (46.929987337866386, -119.02882425044682) and (43.19114225407087, -119.70997639198902) covered by clouds or fogs?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use Sentinel-2 or Landsat 8 for November 29, 2015 - Need to check cloud coverage at two specific points - Sentinel-2 might not have data that early (launched June 2015, limited coverage), so Landsat 8 is safer - Date: 2015-11-29 2. Masking strategy: - This question is ABOUT clouds/fog, so I should NOT mask them - Need to check the cloud probability or QA bands at these specific locations - For Landsat 8: Use QA_PIXEL band to detect clouds - Bit 3 = cloud, Bit 4 = cloud shadow 3. Logic: - Extract cloud information at both points - If both points are cloudy/foggy → A (Yes) - If at least one point is clear → B (No) - Handle C1 (no images), C2 (no valid pixels), C3 (calculation failure) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const point1 = ee.Geometry.Point([−119.02882425044682, 46.929987337866386]); const point2 = ee.Geometry.Point([−119.70997639198902, 43.19114225407087]); const date = '2015-11-29'; const dateStart = ee.Date(date); const dateEnd = dateStart.advance(1, 'day'); // 2. Data Acquisition - Try Landsat 8 let collection = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterDate(dateStart, dateEnd) .filterBounds(point1.union(point2)); let collectionSize = await collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Landsat 8 Images found: ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { // Try wider date range const dateStartWide = dateStart.advance(−3, 'day'); const dateEndWide = dateStart.advance(3, 'day'); collection = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterDate(dateStartWide, dateEndWide) .filterBounds(point1.union(point2)); collectionSize = await collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Landsat 8 Images (±3 days): ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log('No images found for the specified date and locations.'); console.log('C1'); return; } } // 3. Get the closest image const image = collection.sort('CLOUD_COVER').first(); // 4. Extract QA_PIXEL band for cloud detection const qaPixel = image.select('QA_PIXEL'); // Check if QA_PIXEL exists const bandNames = await image.bandNames().getInfo(); console.log(`Available bands: ${bandNames.join(', ')}`); if (!bandNames.includes('QA_PIXEL')) { console.log('QA_PIXEL band not found.'); console.log('D'); return; } // 5. Sample cloud status at both points // Bit 3: Cloud (value 8), Bit 4: Cloud Shadow (value 16) const sample1 = await qaPixel.sample({ region: point1, scale: 30, geometries: true }).first().get('QA_PIXEL').getInfo(); const sample2 = await qaPixel.sample({ region: point2, scale: 30, geometries: true }).first().get('QA_PIXEL').getInfo(); if (sample1 === null || sample2 === null) { console.log('Could not extract QA values at one or both points.'); console.log('C3'); return; } console.log(`Point 1 QA_PIXEL: ${sample1}`); console.log(`Point 2 QA_PIXEL: ${sample2}`); // Check bits for cloud (bit 3 = 8) or cloud shadow (bit 4 = 16) const cloudBit = 8; // 2^3 const shadowBit = 16; // 2^4 const point1Cloudy = (sample1 & cloudBit) !== 0 || (sample1 & shadowBit) !== 0; const point2Cloudy = (sample2 & cloudBit) !== 0 || (sample2 & shadowBit) !== 0; console.log(`Point 1 (46.93, -119.03) cloudy/foggy: ${point1Cloudy}`); console.log(`Point 2 (43.19, -119.71) cloudy/foggy: ${point2Cloudy}`); // 6. Final Answer if (point1Cloudy && point2Cloudy) { console.log('Both locations are covered by clouds or fog.'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('At least one location is NOT covered by clouds or fog.'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
